title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 122
paragraphs: When the Greeks had sent their first-fruits to Delphi, they asked the god on behalf of all whether the first-fruits he had received were fully sufficient and acceptable to him. He said that from the Greeks he had received enough, but not from the Aeginetans, and demanded from them the offering of their prize of valor for the sea-fight at Salamis. On hearing this, the Aeginetans dedicated three gold stars on a bronze ship's mast, which are placed in the corner close to the mixing-bowl of Croesus.
